why: Gleaming Bastion's W/U mode is gated on controlling a basic land; the deck runs zero basics, so it makes coloured mana only on the turn it enters and is a colourless land thereafter. Test a basic Island in its place. EVIDENCE IS mana-analysis, not the goldfish, which cannot rank two lands that make the same colours.
